summary: Comprehensive testing of property management system iteration 2. All new features tested: rooms management, enhanced payments with partial payment support, tenant improvements with Codice Fiscale, reports PDF generation, and notifications. Fixed a bug in GET /api/payments endpoint that caused 500 error when payment records lacked tenant_id field.
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py - Fixed GET /api/payments to handle missing tenant_id field
seed_data_creation: Test data created and cleaned up during test run (TEST_ prefixed records)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features working correctly. Auth uses direct login (POST /api/auth/login) with cookies. Room assignment uses form data (POST /api/rooms/{id}/assign with tenant_id). Payments update tenant.total_paid and invoice.paid_amount. Reports PDF endpoint returns application/pdf content type. Email notifications are MOCKED (logged to console).
